senses.zh_definition: 若原文指历史人名 Cotys：科提斯，见于古代君主姓名；仅凭该形式无法确定是哪一位人物。
senses.en_definition: If intended as the historical proper name Cotys, a name borne by ancient rulers; the particular bearer requires contextual identification.
senses.ms_definition: Jika bentuk ini merujuk kepada nama khas Cotys, nama tersebut digunakan oleh pemerintah purba; tokoh yang dimaksudkan perlu dikenal pasti melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 专名解释是候选辨识，不是已确认的马来语普通词义。克拉科夫国家博物馆出版物记录了博斯普鲁斯统治者 Cotys；自然历史博物馆的 LepIndex 同时记录学名 Ancema cotys。后者是命名用法，不能据此把独立的 cotys 定义成“蝴蝶”。下列仅为历史专名语境中的示例组合，未核实为高频搭配。[历史人名资料](https://doi.org/10.52800/ajst.1.17.a5)；[学名记录](https://www.nhm.ac.uk/our-science/data/lepindex/detail?taxonno=195072)

collocations.en: a coin issued in the name of Cotys

etymology.historical_story: Cotys illustrates why a word list needs its original context. A museum publication discusses a coin issued in the name of a Bosporan ruler called Cotys, while the Natural History Museum records cotys within a butterfly's scientific name. These attestations establish different uses of the spelling, but neither establishes a Malay common noun or the intended source of this token. [Historical source](https://doi.org/10.52800/ajst.1.17.a5); [taxonomic source](https://www.nhm.ac.uk/our-science/data/lepindex/detail?taxonno=195072)
